text: IT has fast inactivation kinetics (τ=20ms) - may not sustain rebound over long protocols. Observed: IT predicts long_step=24.0 vs observed 26.0, error 2.0.
Rebound could be mediated by persistent Na current (INaP) which also produces depolarization. INaP predicts brief_step=8.67, hyperpol_cond_depol=20.33, long_step=32.67 - worse fit than IT.
Ih has slower activation (τ=50ms) - may not activate sufficiently during brief protocols. Observed: Ih predicts long_step=31.7 vs observed 26.0, error 5.7 - much worse than IT's 2.0.
hyperpol_cond_depol shows Ih predicts 19.7 vs observed 19.3 - error of only 0.3, but this single good fit is outweighed by poor long_step fit.
